description: Central dependency-maintenance policy for fileworks repositories.

packageRules.description: Batch routine maintenance into one tested weekly patch release.
Require explicit review for breaking-risk dependency changes.

description: DEC-05: an urgent lane for genuinely time-sensitive vulnerabilities.
Every field below is set explicitly rather than inherited. Renovate's docs
say vulnerability-alert PRs skip the routine queue and may ignore schedule
and concurrency fields, but 'may ignore' is not a guarantee to build a
security lane on, and an unset field would otherwise inherit the weekly
lane's soak and automerge. These are declarative defence-in-depth: they do
not prevent queueing, and nothing here claims they do.
